context.surface: A text cleanup tool and a reporting tool apply a policy for invisible characters.
assumptions: Use synthetic inputs in a local test harness.

review.invariant: URL formatting preserves the result of the documented character cleanup policy.
review.verification: Compare a plain URL control with synthetic text containing characters the policy requires removing. Check the final output and report.

source_observation.summary: The baseline URL handling preserved characters targeted by cleanup. The repaired pipeline passed the local URL regression.
